reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, which is whether it is really tested. At $24.99 with the money-back guarantee I will try one box, and I only take it in the evening so the pre-counted sachet helps me not forget.
objection: A lab report on their own page is only as good as the lab, and I will not know until I scan the code whether it is a real lab. At $29.99 full price I can probably find magnesium cheaper at the store, so I would not reorder without a coupon.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code or product page did not show a real batch report from a lab I can look up, I would not buy.
